") today announces that in the period beginning March 6, 2019 and ending on November 9, 2026, the Company entered into certain loan agreements with certain directors, related parties and Control Persons (as such term is defined in TSX Venture Exchange (the "
) of the Company, pursuant to which the Company was advanced certain amounts of debt by such directors and Control Persons (collectively, the "

"). These related party transactions may refer as non-arm's length transactions. The proceeds of the Debt Transactions were used to fund the Company's ongoing operations and for general corporate commercial purposes. Through inadvertence, the Company did not publicly disseminate the details of the Debt Transactions at the time such Debt Transactions were completed.

The Debt Transactions consisted of transactions among the Company and certain directors and Control Persons of the Company. Paul Lin, a director of the Company, advanced three installments of principal pursuant to the terms of certain promissory notes issued by the Company as follows: (i) on March 6, 2019, Mr. Lin advanced a principal amount of USD$71,073; (ii) on August 27, 2019, Mr. Lin advanced a principal amount of CAD$31,001.60; and (iii) on March 13, 2020, Mr. Lin advanced a principal amount of CAD$27,200.00 (such advances collectively referenced as the "
"). The amounts advanced to the Company pursuant to the Lin Transactions are non-interest bearing, unsecured obligations of the Company, payable on demand.

Tim Seung, a director of the Company, advanced three installments of principal pursuant to the terms of certain promissory notes issued by the Company as follows: (i) on February 14, 2020, Mr. Seung advanced a principal amount of CAD$26,254.00; (ii) on March 31, 2021, Mr. Seung advanced a principal amount of CAD$62,003.20; and (iii) on June 30, 2022, Mr. Seung advanced a principal amount of CAD$41,252.88 (such advances collectively referenced as the "
"). The amounts advanced to the Company pursuant to the Seung Transactions are non-interest bearing, unsecured obligations of the Company, payable on demand.

The amount of principal advanced to the Company pursuant to the Lin Transactions and the Seung Transactions remain outstanding and payable obligations of the Company. The Company has not repaid any amounts owing by it to Mr. Lin and Mr. Seung pursuant to the Lin Transactions and the Seung Transactions, respectively.

On November 21, 2022, and subsequently thereafter until October 31, 2025, New Journey advanced certain amounts of principal to the Company (the "
") pursuant to the terms and conditions of a loan agreement and ancillary promissory note documentation entered into by and among the Company and New Journey (collectively, the "

"). Pursuant to the terms of the New Journey Documentation, the term of each advance of principal matures on the earlier of: (a) five years from the date of the advance; or (b) the date a resolution is passed to dissolve New Journey. Interest accrues on the principal amounts at 6% for the duration of the term of such advance. As at October 31, 2026, the Company is indebted to New Journey pursuant to the New Journey Transactions in the aggregate amount of USD$2,182,736.90 (CAD$3,047,100.71).
On January 1, 2020, and subsequently thereafter until September 16, 2022, Hua Star Capital USA LLC ("
") advanced certain amounts of principal to the Company (the "
") pursuant to the terms and conditions of a loan agreement and ancillary promissory note documentation entered into by and among the Company and Hua Star (collectively, the "

"). Hua Star is a related party of the Company as it is controlled by Mr. Seung, a director of the Company. Pursuant to the terms of the Hua Star Documentation, the term of each advance of principal matures on the earlier of: (a) five years from the date of the advance; or (b) the date a resolution is passed to dissolve Hua Star. Interest accrues on the principal amounts at 6% for the duration of the term of such advance. As of October 31, 2026, the Company is indebted to Hua Star pursuant to the Hua Star Transactions in the aggregate amount of USD$1,498,000.00 (CAD$2,091,208.00).

As of October 31, 2026, the company has not paid out any interest accrued to New Journey on the amount of USD$484,531.40 (CAD $676,405.83) and to Hua Star on the amount of USD$300,021.50 (CAD $418,830.01). The company estimates it would borrow up to USD$410,000.00 in promissory notes from New Journey in the next 12 months.
Exchange rate used in translation of USD amount to CAD amounts is 1.396 on October 30, 2026, published on bank of Canada website.

Following notification of the delayed disclosure of the Debt Transactions by the TSXV, the Company has been working diligently to provide the required disclosure to its shareholders and to the TSXV in respect of the Debt Transactions. The Company continues to undertake to provide the necessary and timely disclosure of its material business activities, as required by the policies of the TSXV.
The Company will provide shareholders with updates on the status of its ongoing activities as information becomes available.
